name: 2026-11-devready-doctor
description: The package is a well-masked dropper. In multiple places, especially in a PTH file, it downloads and executes a remote executable. To activate, the base URL has to be handled over via an environment variable. This behavior is commented as installing a development tool ("node") and an agent (including verification of the hash fcaa596240007d9082983c206fb51cbf1a4d25ba31c9fd8a541bcc45c8b78c35), but the behavior cannot be explained by any legitimate tool. The related GitHub account was created the same day as publishing the package.
